connector_type: NACS (North American Charging Standard) / Magic Dock J1772

common_error_codes.meaning: Ground fault circuit interruption (current leakage to ground detected).
common_error_codes.fix: Inspect output cable, vehicle inlet pins, and verify ground conductor integrity (<25 ohms).

common_error_codes.meaning: Ground Path Loss (Wall Connector is not detecting a safe ground bond).
common_error_codes.fix: Test supply ground connection in wire box, check for loose neutral-ground bonding.

common_error_codes.meaning: High internal temperature detected at terminal block or charge handle.
common_error_codes.fix: Re-torque terminal block lugs to factory specification (50 in-lbs) and inspect for resistive heating.

common_error_codes.meaning: Internet or Power Sharing Cluster communication interruption.
common_error_codes.fix: Reset Wi-Fi commission portal or clear conflicting load-balancing cluster pairing.

common_error_codes.meaning: Power-sharing communication handshake timeout or internal relay fault.
common_error_codes.fix: Cycle breaker, audit CAN-bus communication wire, or replace power control PCB.

common_error_codes.meaning: Hardware over-voltage or under-voltage detected from incoming utility feed.
common_error_codes.fix: Measure L1-L2 line voltage; contact utility if phase drops below 200V or exceeds 255V.

warranty_status_notes: Tesla offers a 48-month residential warranty for Gen 3 Wall Connectors installed by licensed contractors. Proof of certified installation required.
repairability_rating: High (Modular terminal wire box and replaceable faceplates; circuit board repairable if out of warranty).
description: As the most common EV charger in Northern Colorado, Tesla Wall Connectors deliver up to 48A (11.5 kW). Our technicians stock genuine Tesla parts, replacement handles, and high-temperature terminal lugs.

common_error_codes.meaning: Critical internal fault or CCID ground-fault test failure.
common_error_codes.fix: Full power cycle; if red persists, test ground impedance and internal contactor coil.

common_error_codes.meaning: Wi-Fi connection lost or cloud communication timeout.
common_error_codes.fix: Reboot router, re-pair via ChargePoint Bluetooth app setup, or reconfigure 2.4GHz band.

common_error_codes.meaning: Firmware update stuck in bootloader loop.
common_error_codes.fix: Hard reboot via breaker or factory re-flash using ChargePoint technician tools.

warranty_status_notes: ChargePoint Home Flex includes a 3-year limited parts warranty backed by 24/7 customer support.
repairability_rating: Moderate to High (Modular cord assembly is user-replaceable; terminal blocks require precise torque).
description: ChargePoint Home Flex is a favorite across Northern Colorado for its adjustable 16A-50A charging rates. We diagnose WiFi disconnects, cable clip breakage, and terminal block overheating.

common_error_codes.meaning: Ground fault detected on output charging cable.
common_error_codes.fix: Check for moisture in J1772 connector pins or damaged cable jacket.

common_error_codes.meaning: High internal unit temperature exceeded safe threshold.
common_error_codes.fix: Check ambient garage temperature, inspect terminal wire connections, clean intake vents.

common_error_codes.meaning: JuicePass app cloud migration disconnection.
common_error_codes.fix: Reset device network credentials or reconfigure to local stand-alone mode.

warranty_status_notes: Following the Enel X North America software transition, many JuiceBox units require localized offline configuration or custom board diagnostics.
repairability_rating: High (Internal relay contactors and terminal blocks are discrete and replaceable).
description: Many Weld County homeowners have JuiceBox units installed through utility programs. Following software transitions, we specialize in offline conversion, relay replacements, and cable repairs.

common_error_codes.meaning: Internal error, vehicle communication error, or ground fault.
common_error_codes.fix: Perform factory safety self-test check via myWallbox Bluetooth app.

common_error_codes.meaning: Earth ground presence missing or high impedance on protective conductor.
common_error_codes.fix: Verify main panel ground bonding and test auxiliary earthing plate.

common_error_codes.meaning: Charger is locked or waiting for authorization.
common_error_codes.fix: Authenticate through myWallbox app or disable auto-lock feature.

warranty_status_notes: 3-year standard manufacturer warranty covering parts and factory defects.
repairability_rating: Moderate (Ultra-compact chassis requires specialized micro-screwdriver tooling).
description: Wallbox Pulsar Plus is known for its compact footprint and Bluetooth/WiFi connectivity. We handle halo light diagnostic troubleshooting, smart schedule resets, and power boost meter calibrations.

popular_models: Emporia Vue Home Energy Management Bundle

common_error_codes.meaning: GFCI trip or ground missing.
common_error_codes.fix: Test ground circuit with loop impedance meter; inspect for line noise.

common_error_codes.meaning: Emporia Vue automated load shedding threshold triggered.
common_error_codes.fix: Re-calibrate Vue current transformers (CTs) inside electrical panel.

warranty_status_notes: 3-year warranty from Emporia (Colorado-based company headquartered in Littleton, CO).
repairability_rating: High (Local Colorado manufacturer with excellent replacement parts availability).
description: Proudly designed in Colorado, Emporia chargers pair with energy monitoring systems. We are Front Range experts in pairing Emporia chargers with Vue smart panels and fixing communication dropouts.

connector_type: J1772 (Premium cold-weather flexible cable rated to -22°F)

common_error_codes.meaning: Ground fault detected or GFCI self-test failure.
common_error_codes.fix: Inspect plug contacts for water condensation or debris.

common_error_codes.meaning: Relay contact stuck or welded in open/closed position.
common_error_codes.fix: Replace heavy-duty internal mechanical contactor assembly.

common_error_codes.meaning: High internal temperature detected on input terminals.
common_error_codes.fix: Tighten internal DIP switch terminals and verify copper conductor gauge.

warranty_status_notes: 3-year replacement warranty; built in North America with robust NEMA 4 cast aluminum housing.
repairability_rating: Very High (Industrial mechanical contactors and heavy-duty serviceable chassis).
description: Grizzl-E is widely favored in Colorado for its rugged cast-aluminum, cold-weather proof enclosure. We replace worn J1772 cables, adjust internal amperage DIP switches, and service heavy-duty contactors.
